knobs.name: partial_dump_first
knobs.mechanism: DUMP_COVERAGE(0, 1) inserted before DUMP_COVERAGE(0, 0): the first chunk of object 0 is streamed twice (byte-identical, so fth coverage-system still reassembles), the plan's exactly-once check on chunk (object 0, offset 0) fails

knobs.name: valid_range_instead
knobs.mechanism: DUMP_COVERAGE(65535, 1) rewritten to (0, 1): the command is accepted and streams one chunk where the negative control expects a rejection
